summary: The 4979eaa5 through 32069ccd remediation is deterministic, provenance-pinned, quarantine-clean, and fixes the stale Review A findings about fabricated initializer transitions, path-global occurrence merging, omitted alias imports/required files, and collapsed current/withdrawn source classes. The source denominator is still not correct enough for Phase 4: the scene/state pass covers only typed useState literal unions and a narrow setter pattern, omitting explicit Zustand/runtime states and transitions; the purported independent human path is generated by replaying the Phase-1 denominator rather than independently discovering a second denominator; and the identity ledger omits ten exact frozen catalog identities. These are unresolved blocking denominator mismatches under the frozen stop-loss contract.
blocking_findings: Critical — scene/state/transition coverage is not exhaustive under FR2. generate_phase1_denominators.py:415-519 recognizes only component names ending Game/Screen/Scene plus typed useState literal unions, then retains guarded setters matching one bounded regex or only the first unguarded initializer edge. The committed artifact consequently contains 55 scene occurrences, 36 state-literal occurrences, and only 11 transitions. Frozen source apps/advantage-games/src/store/usePotionRushStore.ts:11-13,32,131-170 explicitly defines GameState MENU/PLAYING/PAUSED/GAME_OVER, CauldronState IDLE/BREWING/WARNING/COMPLETED, customer states, the MENU initializer, and the PLAYING transition; none of those exact state occurrences exists in scene-state-denominator.json. Frozen apps/advantage-games/src/store/useRPGBattleStore.ts:4-17,60-129 likewise defines battle status, turn, pose, selection-step states and transitions through playing/victory/defeat/player/enemy/location/ready, but no store occurrence or transition is recorded. This is at least one denominator mismatch and triggers phase0-input-freeze.json.stop_loss.denominator_mismatches_before_stop=1.

High — the Phase-2 path is not an independent full human-source discovery capable of finding Phase-1 omissions, contrary to FR3. generate_phase2_human_discovery.py:692-720 loads every Phase-1 artifact as its input denominator, and lines 781-908 mechanically iterate those authored source, graph, surface, asset, history, and discrepancy collections and relabel exact locator revalidation as human review. The surface loop at lines 817-828 can only reproduce Phase-1 scene/state/transition rows; therefore it reports 102/102 surfaces and zero uncovered even while the frozen Zustand states above are absent from both paths. Deterministic revalidation is valuable, but it is not a separately discovered raw-source denominator and cannot establish dual-discovery agreement.

Medium — game-identity-ledger.json does not enumerate the complete frozen catalog identity denominator required by FR1. build_identity_ledger at generate_phase1_denominators.py:380-412 iterates only page-derived identities. The frozen gameCards.ts catalog contains 27 exact card IDs, while the ledger contains 17 page identities; ten catalog-withdrawn identities are absent from the ledger entirely: archers-revenge, astral-mage, griffin-riders-escape, griffin-sky-joust, gryphon-patrol, paladins-twin-soul, realm-carver, sorcerer-ziggurat, spellweavers-run, and storm-castle-tower. Later Phase-2 program-disposition records do not repair the required identity ledger or give Phase 3 a mechanical catalog-identity comparison set.
remediated_stale_findings: 4979eaa5 now binds initializer-to-setter edges to the exact typed initializer and preserves path-scoped scene/state occurrences; the previously unsupported Devourer Slime ended-to-playing transition is gone.
The current source denominator includes 579 file records, all five previously omitted registration/Measure files, and 946 graph edges including the previously omitted application-alias edges.
The identity ledger now retains simultaneous current-page-source and catalog-withdrawn-registration states for Dragon Flight, Magic Defense, Dragon Rider, and Dungeon Liberator.
